_doc: FE-P7 (2026-05-26) production bundle budget. NOT a magic number: maxGzipBytes is DERIVED from a measured baseline (measure-bundle.mjs --build) times a documented headroom factor. Re-measure + re-derive when the baseline legitimately shifts. Rationale + procedure: docs/architecture/frontend/performance-budget.md.
measuredCommitNote: Re-derived on main 275069b with the canonical tool (`node scripts/measure-bundle.mjs --build`); reproduced twice, identical buildId. Previous baseline 318274 B was measured 2026-06-26 IN THE MONOREPO, before this box existed — so a per-commit attribution back to it is not possible here (the delivery box carries no monorepo history, EXTRACTED_FROM.md). WHY IT DRIFTED UNSEEN: the gate had not executed in CI since 2026-08-31. `frontend.yml`'s `build` job sets `defaults.run.working-directory: apps/web`, and the api-artifacts mirror step used a repo-root path, so the job died with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before ever reaching measure/budget. Every step after it — codegen, codegen drift, lint, unit tests, production build, this budget — was dead for five days (fixed 2026-09-05). The overage is accumulated drift that no one could see, not a single regression. NOT A LAZY-LOADING REGRESSION: the two observability SDKs (sentry-runtime 77,502 B + tracing 36,415 B = 113,917 B, 28% of this total) are still absent from the initial-load path — see initialLoadPathJs below. That is the failure this budget's sibling metric exists to catch, and it did not happen. MEASURED TRAJECTORY inside this box: b7c60bf (2026-09-04, before the sample-domain wave) 396,634 B; 89a4e38 (2026-09-05, before PR #68) 399,493 B; 275069b (this baseline) 402,509 B — i.e. PR #68 contributed +3,016 B and the rest is spread across the waves before it. Growth is route/feature chunks, all lazy.

initialLoadPathJs._doc: Wave fe-w4-bundle-observability-cost (2026-07-31) — a SECOND budget on a DIFFERENT metric, using the same measured-derived discipline as the total above. Metric = the entry <script type="module"> in dist/index.html plus every <link rel="modulepreload"> it declares: exactly the JavaScript a user must download before the app can run. Lazily import()ed route and observability chunks are excluded by construction (Vite only preloads the entry's static import graph); CSS and .map files are out of scope. WHY A SECOND METRIC: totalGzipBytes is blind to *when* a chunk is fetched. This wave moved 114,561 B gzip off the initial path and the total barely moved — so a total-only budget scores both this win and its exact regression as 'no change', which is why the defect it was supposed to catch survived for two months.
initialLoadPathJs.measuredCommitNote: 래칫 — 내림. `jose` 를 초기 경로에서 걷어냈다(perf/jose-off-initial-load-path, origin/main d977275 위에서 측정). 177,967 → 171,007 B (-6,960 B). 엔트리 그래프는 여전히 8 청크이고 순서만 그대로다: index 76,338 / react 64,913 / validation 13,774 / query 12,998 / lang 1,014 / theme 713 / runtime 638 / density 619 — 줄어든 것은 index 뿐이다(83,298 → 76,338). WHY IT WAS THERE: `session.ts::restoreSession` 이 `verifyIdToken` 을 정적 import 하고 그것이 부팅에서 실행되므로 `oidc-pkce.ts` 가 값으로 끌던 `jose` 전체가 엔트리 그래프에 있었다. 그런데 그 코드가 **실행**되는 시점은 로그인 콜백과 침묵 갱신 둘뿐이고 둘 다 이미 async 다 — 도달 가능성만 정적이고 실행은 지연돼 있었다. 이 예산이 재는 것이 정확히 그 차이다. ⚠️ TREE-SHAKING TRAP (실측): `oidc-pkce.ts` 에서 `import('jose')` 를 직접 부르면 동적 import 가 **네임스페이스 전체**를 요구해 Rollup 이 아무것도 버리지 못한다 — 비동기 청크가 모듈 78개 / 16,960 B 가 되고 상자 총계가 +10,060 B 늘었다. 동적 경계를 자기 모듈(`src/auth/jose-verify.ts`)에 두면 그 안쪽은 평범한 정적 그래프라 트리셰이킹이 그대로 돌아, 같은 청크가 모듈 29개 / 7,356 B 가 되고 총계 증가는 +373 B 로 사라진다. 「초기 경로에서 뺐다」와 「싸게 뺐다」는 다른 축이고, 총계 예산은 후자만 본다. NOT A TOTAL-BUDGET CHANGE: 총계 기준선(402,509 B)은 **의도적으로 그대로 둔다** — 관측값 402,882 B 는 상한 483,011 B 아래이고, 기준선을 올리면 상한이 함께 올라간다(래칫의 반대 방향).
initialLoadPathJs.headroomRationale: 10% rather than the total budget's 20%: the initial path is the metric users feel, and it should not silently absorb a whole SDK. The resulting headroom is 17,101 B — still deliberately SMALLER than the smallest chunk the 2026-07-31 wave removed (tracing, 36,415 B gzip), so re-gluing either SDK back into the entry graph trips the gate immediately instead of being swallowed. 같은 이유로 `jose`(7,356 B gzip, 2026-09-05 분리)가 정적 import 로 되돌아오면 이 예산이 그것을 잡는다 — 총계 예산은 그 되붙임을 0으로 채점한다. Ratchet: lower it when a wave measurably shrinks the initial path; raising it needs a recorded justification.
